caption:
A viral tech concept is drawing attention after showcasing the possibility of running AI models locally from a USB drive or portable storage device, without relying on cloud-based services.

The idea is based on local AI, where the model and required software can run directly on compatible hardware instead of sending every request to an online server.

This could offer several advantages:

✅ Works without an internet connection
🔒 Greater control over your data
☁️ Less dependence on cloud services
💻 Useful for offline environments
📦 Portable AI setup for compatible computers

However, running AI locally isn't as simple as plugging a pendrive into every computer. The model size, available RAM, storage speed, CPU/GPU capabilities, and software compatibility all affect performance.

As smaller and more efficient AI models continue to improve, offline and portable AI could become increasingly practical for everyday users.

💬 Would you carry an AI assistant on a pendrive if it worked completely offline? 👀
